transcript: Speaker A (Auntie): Welcome to our homestay. This is your room... [English] Speaker B (Reporter): Auntie ji, aap pahad ki homestay chala rahi hain aur videshi tourist se English mein baat kar rahi hain? [Auntie, you run a mountain homestay and speak to foreign tourists in English?] Speaker A: Arre beti, pahad pe rehti hoon to kya hua, duniya se kati thodi hoon. [Oh daughter, just because I live in the mountains doesn't mean I'm cut off from the world.] Speaker B: Auntie ji, mujhe batayein, yeh English aapne seekhi kahan se? [Auntie, tell me, where did you learn this English from?] Speaker A: Beti, 15 saal se yeh ghar chala rahi hoon... [Daughter, I've been running this house for 15 years... She explains how she lost bookings and ratings on Airbnb due to poor English, then her son downloaded the English Seekho app for a ₹1 trial. She practiced 15 minutes daily with the AI coach, improved her ratings to 4.9, became a Superhost, and increased her income from ₹15,000 to ₹1.2 lakhs. She encourages others to learn.] Speaker C (Voiceover): To install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
